title: Elodie and the Protocol
author: Beatrix Zhou
blurb: Tamsin Thackeray, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
